title: Gem Ai
description: Bring your world to life with a companion that actually listens. It chats with you and handles the heavy lifting by running commands on the fly.
body:
This mod adds a Ai to your world 

It can run multiple commands to help you build and chat while you play. It's still in beta, so it isn't perfect. it sometimes struggles with complex stuff or loses its train of thought. This is my first mod and I plan to add way more things to it later, like:

​Long-term memory,

​Better command creation, 

​and Support for more game versions

to use it just run

/gemini {your text}

It will prompt you for your API key, which is free unless you're using a paid plan.

​So yeah, have fun and enjoy! :)
